proof_summary: For \(n=550172\), reducing a putative hit of residue \(63945\) modulo \(401\) forces its index into one of 200 explicit classes modulo \(80200\); a finite check of these classes rules out every index below \(16331504\) (while a covering computation through \(17135927\) establishes existence), so \(a(550172)\ge16331504\). An explicit prime count gives \(p_{550172}\le8165753\), hence \(2(p_{550172}-1)\le16331504\), contradicting the claimed strict inequality.
